thread:
mira (product): Heads-up — sketching a long-term approach for multi-region + multi-tenant isolation. Proposal name: 'islands' (region-pairing + traffic fabric). Wanted early feedback on launch criteria and customer-driven asks.

jordan (arch): I like the naming, feels clearer than 'slices'. Quick Q: are islands strict single-tenant nodes or multi-tenant with hard isolation?

mira (product): thinking 3 isolation tiers: 'shared' (soft limits, best-effort), 'restricted' (per-tenant pools, eviction policies), 'quarantine' (dedicated HW or VPC). Launch criteria idea: SLA band defined, migration runbook, and at least one anchor customer for each tier.

sam (infra): +1 on tiers. We need concrete capacity math for restricted lanes — expected peak qps per tenant, burst model, and region-pair failover plan. Also want to avoid too many ad-hoc tenant pools.

kai (sre): From ops: must have automated drain + graceful fallback to next island. Monitoring: token-level latency SLO + service-level error rate per island. Rollout gating: canary with 5% traffic, 24h health window, auto-rollback on error spike > 3x baseline.

lisa (cs): For customers: they ask for region guarantee and data residency. They'll accept 'restricted' if we provide clear SLAs and migration assistance (schema: timeline, downtime, rollback). Need pricing band per isolation tier.

jordan (arch): Rough routing policy prototype (pseudo-config):
```
route fabric:
  - match: tenant.experimental == true
    prefer: island-eastpair
    fallback: shared-global
  - match: tenant.sla == "restricted"
    allocate: restricted-pool-{regionPair}
    eviction: preempt-best-effort
```
This is just to show intent: routing fabric decides by tenant labels + SLA band.

mira (product): Good. Also adding 'egress shaping' as a hard requirement for restricted islands so we can cap noisy tenants. That feeds into pricing and acceptance criteria.

sam (infra): Implementation notes: need control-plane flags to pin tenant -> island, API for ops to reassign with safe migration steps, and capacity telemetry per island. Maybe reuse existing prefix/KV cache segregation to reduce cross-tenant noise.

kai (sre): Runbook sketch for migration:
- pre-checks: model size, kv cache warmup estimate, expected token growth
- canary: 1% traffic for 1h, measure p99 latency and errors
- ramp: 1->10->50->100 over 48h with health gates
- rollback: immediate traffic shift to fallback route

lisa (cs): Customer asks to see a checklist we can share. Can product draft a one-pager with timelines and expected risk for customers who choose restricted islands?

mira (product): Will do. Plan for next steps: 1) Jordan to formalize routing fabric spec (policy language + sample configs). 2) Sam to size restricted pools and propose autoscale policy. 3) Kai to write canary/rollback gates into oncall playbook. 4) Product to draft customer one-pager and pricing bands.

deploy-bot: Deployed routing-fabric/proposal v0.1 to #docs-preview (artifact: /artifacts/routing-fabric-v0.1).

jordan (arch): I'll drop the first spec draft by EOD Fri. Will include example policy DSL and edge-case semantics (cross-island kv cache, fallback ordering).

sam (infra): I can mock capacity numbers by Monday if you share expected tenant profiles.

mira (product): I'll circulate a short survey to the top 10 tenants for profile data today. Thanks all — want to lock launch criteria by next Thurs so PM can prioritize roadmap items. :rocket:
